+def _van_der_corput(index, base):
+    """Radical inverse / vdc sequence for one dimension."""
+    result = 0.0
+    f = 1.0 / base
+    i = index
+    while i > 0:
+        result += f * (i % base)
+        i //= base
+        f /= base
+    return result
+
+def _halton_point(index, bounds):
+    """Generate a Halton point (low-discrepancy) for given bounds."""
+    pt = []
+    for d, (lo, hi) in enumerate(bounds):
+        base = _PRIMES[d]
+        u = _van_der_corput(index, base)
+        pt.append(lo + (hi - lo) * u)
+    return pt
